tests.procedure: Accurately weigh empty crucible previously dried at 105 °C and cooled in desiccator (W0). Weigh accurately 1.000 g into crucible (W1 = empty plate + material). Dry in calibrated oven at 105 °C for 4 h, cool in desiccator, weigh (W2). Repeat to constant weight. % LOD = ((W1 - W2) / (W1 - W0)) x 100.

details.formula: % Loss on Drying = ((W1 - W2) / (W1 - W0)) x 100

tests.source: Vitamin K1__SM- Vitamin K1 new + Micro.txt:30

tests.procedure: Transfer 1.0 g to crucible, add sulfuric acid to wet, char at low temperature, add 2 mL nitric acid and 5 drops sulfuric acid, heat until fumes cease, ignite in muffle at 1000 °C until carbon burned off. Digest residue with 4 mL 6 N HCl on steam bath 15 min, evaporate to dryness. Moisten with 1 drop HCl, add 10 mL hot water, digest 2 min. Neutralize with 6 N NH4OH to litmus, adjust with 1 N acetic acid to pH 3.0-4.0, dilute to 40 mL. Standard: 2 mL Lead Standard (20 µg Pb) similarly adjusted. To each add 2 mL pH 3.5 buffer and 1.2 mL thioacetamide-glycerin base TS, dilute to 50 mL, stand 2 min, compare colors against white surface.

details.standardLead: 2 mL of 20 µg/mL Pb standard = 40 µg (20 ppm limit for 1 g sample)

tests.source: Vitamin K1__SM- Vitamin K1 new + Micro.txt:31

tests.procedure: Weigh accurately about 0.15 g (Wt). Dissolve in 15 mL glacial acetic acid in stoppered flask fitted with valve. Add 15 mL 2 M hydrochloric acid and 1 g zinc powder. Close flask, allow to stand in dark for 60 min, shaking occasionally. Filter through absorbent cotton, wash with three 10-mL portions of carbon dioxide-free water into filtrate. Add 0.1 mL ferroin solution and immediately titrate with 0.1 M ceric ammonium sulphate to endpoint (E.P). Each mL of 0.1 M ceric ammonium sulphate is equivalent to 0.00861 g of Vitamin K. % = (E.P x 0.00861 x molarity x 100 x 100) / (Wt x 0.1 x (100 - LOD)).

details.reduction: 1 g zinc powder, 60 min in dark with occasional shaking
details.equivalenceFactor: 0.00861 g Vitamin K per mL of 0.1 M titrant
details.formula: % = (E.P x 0.00861 x molarity x 100 x 100) / (Wt x 0.1 x (100 - LOD))
details.specBasis: dried basis (corrected by LOD in formula)
details.titrantStandardization: 25 mL ceric ammonium sulfate + 2 g KI + 150 mL water, add 1 mL starch TS, titrate with 0.1 N sodium thiosulfate VS
details.thiosulfateStandardization: 210 mg potassium dichromate dried at 120 °C 4 h + 100 mL water + 3 g KI + 2 g NaHCO3 + 5 mL HCl, stand 10 min dark, titrate with thiosulfate with starch TS indicator
details.reference: Analytical Method validation for Vitamin K1 5%
